description: Land Acquisition - Thopawewa & Polonnaruwa, Thamankaduwa D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District
categorisation: This gazette content is a declaration under the Land Acquisition Act for the acquisition of specific land parcels for public purpose. It contains detailed descriptions of multiple land lots with boundaries, extents, and locations, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisition matters. While it mentions a government minister's name, this is incidental to the land acquisition declaration and does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments, or detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger Types 1-3 classification.
